messages:
Harper (Events): Stream go-live in 10. Quick change: moving roadmap to after Q&A so we can surface more live questions. Can AV confirm recording + captions?
Diego (Eng): Doing a warm test: encoder temp spiked on the docked laptop when running 1080/60. Dropping to 720/30 and lowering bitrate to 3.5Mbps as a precaution.
Zoe (Audio): Noticed low-level echo on the stage mono mix during rehearsal. I'm switching to the backup mixing desk and re-patching stage returns. Will test bleed.
Harper (Events): If audio/mix swap runs >90s we'll call a 2-min warm buffer. Also need someone to pin a caption-lag note in the chat.
Tess (Comms): Pinning: "Live captions may lag ~20-30s; recording will be posted after the event."
recording-bot: Stream health check OK. Ingest token expiry in 19m. Ingest URL: https://ingest.internal/streams/199555
Kai (Eng): Enabled encoder auto-failover to alternate regional ingest if latency spikes. Also set reconnect retries to 8.
Diego (Eng): 720/30 + 3.5Mbps stable for 2m, temps back in range. No dropped frames seen.
Zoe (Audio): Backup desk patched, echo gone. Levels look good. :thumbsup:
Maya (Product): Jules, prefer Q&A first or condensed roadmap before Q&A? We can shorten demos to keep time.
Jules (CEO): Let's start with Q&A, then a 12-min condensed roadmap. Anything needing deep tech detail we can move to follow-up threads.
Harper (Events): Backup recording plan: local capture on Tess's laptop + cloud ingest. Tess will upload raw within 60m post-event.
Tess (Comms): Confirmed, I'll upload and drop notes into the all-hands drive.
Harper (Events): Final checklist: captions pinned, encoder fallback set, audio swapped, recording backup in place. Warm count T-3. If anything blocks start, I'll call the pause.
Maya (Product): Follow-ups: 1) collect unanswered Qs and owners 2) upload demo clips 3) timestamp transcript and link in follow-up thread.
Jules (CEO): Thank you team. Run on time but prioritize quality; call it if anything risks the recording.
Harper (Events): Thanks all — starting final warm count.
